reviewNotes: Reviewed all 88 speech keys against all 16 cards and explicit furigana in data/pages61-autumn-winter.json. Contextual topic は rendered わ; object を rendered お. No directional へ present. Preserved lexical はごたえ, はる, はつがつお, はも, はくさい, 葉 は, すいはん and lexical ほうれんそう. Checked まつたけ, どびんむし, でんぷんしつ, かんろに, だいだいいろ, ぎょたい, もどりがつお, ひすいいろ, りょくおう, ぎんなん, こまい, かんぶり, しゅっせうお, せいしょくよう, しらこ, にふくめる, すいくち and ゆずがま against source furigana. Loanwords rendered in hiragana. Display text and lookup keys unchanged. No listening or pitch-accent verification.
